messages:
alex p: Quick sync — cloudcatalog integration listing requires SOC2 excerpt, penetration test report, supplier questionnaire, and presigned artifacts. Need clarity on owners + press timing. cc: @sam @tia @jon
sam s: I can own SOC2 + pen triage. What level of excerpt do partners accept? full scan report or redacted summary?
tia legal: Partners want redacted PII- and IP-sensitive bits. We'll create a template for redaction guidance. Legal needs redaction owner per partner.
jon product: Marketing wants 2-week lead for joint announcement. We should freeze artifacts 3 days prior.
nisha se: For SI integrators, we need sample configs + integration logs. Who will upload to S3?
alex p: @nisha we'll ask SI to upload to our intake bucket. Partnerships will track manifests.
sam s: Security to verify redaction and confirm secure presign. Can infra provide presign workflow? @infra-bot
infra-bot: Presign workflow & example commands:

aws s3 cp ./artifact.zip s3://marketplace-intake/cloudcatalog/ && 
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-intake/cloudcatalog/artifact.zip --expires-in 172800

We recommend TTL=2 days (172800s). Please include access control: presign links only in manifest, not public index.
tia legal: Can we add SHA256 checksums to manifest? helps auditors.
alex p: Yes — manifest should include filename, sha256, artifact-type (soc/excerpt/pen/qna), owner-email, presign-url (once issued).
jon product: Action items: Partnerships collect artifacts by May 10, Security verify by May 12, Legal redaction signoff by May 14, Marketing announce May 20. Is that cadence ok?
nisha se: :+1: I can coordinate SI artifact upload windows (preferred slot May 8-9).
sam s: I'll start pen-scan triage on May 11 if artifacts ready. Also will need contact for third-party witness (if required).
alex p: I'll send calendar invites and create a shared spreadsheet with manifest template. Tagging owners in doc.
tia legal: I'll draft redaction guidance and share by EOD today.
jon product: If any blockers on compliance evidence, flag ASAP — we can't ship announcement without signoff.
alex p: :thumbsup: thanks all — I'll post the manifest link once created.
